# sutramx_regions (Data Source)

SutramX probe locations. Use `code` in `sutramx_monitor.regions`. Which codes a monitor may use depends on the plan and billing market. Does not need an API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sutramx_regions" "online" {
  online_only = true
}

output "region_codes" {
  value = data.sutramx_regions.online.codes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `online_only` (Boolean) Only locations whose probes are online now.

### Read-Only

- `codes` (List of String) Location codes, in activation order.
- `regions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `city` (String)
- `code` (String)
- `continent` (String)
- `country` (String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
- `latitude` (Number)
- `longitude` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `online` (Boolean)
